detector_config_sha256_note: Not applicable: this benchmark performed CPU input reconstruction and identity checks only; it made no detector calls.

environment.cpu_model_note: The processor model was not recorded.

memory_measurement.combined_peak_method_note: The preserved summary labels the combined two- and four-worker values as approximate observations but does not record how they were sampled.
memory_measurement.parent_process_method: Windows psapi GetProcessMemoryInfo PeakWorkingSetSize, sampled after the timed revalidation call
memory_measurement.parent_process_scope_note: The parent-process value excludes spawned worker-process peaks and must not be treated as total memory use.

statistics_note: Each worker count has one completed observation; the reported speedups are ratios of those single wall-time observations, not distribution statistics.
timing_boundary: time.perf_counter around revalidate_primary_inputs; FrozenInputSource loading and JSON serialization excluded
working_tree_note: The measurement recorded commit 492cd492 with tracked implementation changes present; use these timings as historical engineering evidence, not portable hardware guarantees.
